prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Full bleed path choice screen redesign: Redesigns the path choice screen into a full bleed layout with interactive choice cards showcasing preset vs custom setup experiences.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "full_bleed", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "asset": "asset:path_options_cards", "style": "emphasis", "action": "choose"}]}}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout adoption certificate redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen to a stage layout featuring a framed certificate display.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "image", "asset": "asset:stage_certificate_frame", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet audio behavior preferences screen: Adds a new pet audio preference screen before completion allowing users to set default sound levels and quiet hours.
   config: {"new_sound_preferences": {"headline": "Set Pet Sound & Mute Rules", "body": "Choose whether your pet makes soft sounds, speaks on click, or stays quiet while you work.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Pet Sound Mode", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_sound_preferences"]}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet desktop animation preview flow: Adds an interactive idle animation tester component to the pick friend screen so users can preview pet behaviors live on desktop background.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "preview", "text": "Preview Desktop Idle Animations", "asset": "asset:pet_animation_preview", "style": "emphasis", "action": "play"}]}}
4: [sign_in, redesign] Spotlight layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout highlighting single-click account login and pet data restoration.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "button", "label": "Continue with Saved Account", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Existing account pet restoration headline: Updates the sign-in screen headline to emphasize that logging in immediately restores existing pets and cloud saves.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets & Cloud Progress"}}
6: [home, wait_info] Graphics engine preparation checklist on waiting screen: Adds a detailed rendering progress checklist component on the waiting screen showing GPU shader compilation and sprite loading.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Preparing desktop graphics layer & pet sprites...", "style": "subtle"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet right-click menu guidance hint: Adds a hint on the home intro screen explaining that right-clicking the pet on desktop opens pet controls, mute, and hide options.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet on your desktop anytime to change settings, mute sounds, or hide it."}}
8: [home, notification] Display resolution compatibility notification on waiting screen: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to inform users as soon as desktop display scaling optimization completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you the moment your pet is rendered and ready on your desktop."}}
9: [adoption, copy] Custom pet avatar quality reassurance copy: Updates the photo upload body text to explain how the app automatically enhances uploaded photos into clear 3D desktop avatars.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"body": "Upload any photo of your pet. Our graphics engine automatically sharpens lighting and creates a clean 3D desktop companion."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the path choice layout while preserving both preset and custom options inside onboarding.
Replacing the certificate image with a simple frame loses the required official stamp on the adoption certificate.
Adds a valid new pet audio preference screen after home_intro within onboarding.
Adds a preview component to the pick_friend screen within onboarding.
Redesigns the sign-in layout while keeping the sign-in functionality inside onboarding.
Updates headline copy on the sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Adds a rendering progress checklist component to the waiting screen.
Adds menu guidance hints to the home_intro screen within onboarding.
Enables readiness notifications and hints on the waiting screen.
Updates photo upload body copy to explain avatar generation without violating rules.
